1. FY25 had margin expansion, and margins were maintained at 21% in FY26 and H1 FY27 [T1 p.35].
2. Acquisitions impact margins by 50 bps as a full-year headwind [T1 p.35].
3. Headwinds include compensation rollouts (effective October and January), acquisition amortization, and the seasonally slower part of the year, partially offset by Project Maximus [T1 p.35].
4. AI projects generally have better pricing and margins, though they also carry higher talent costs [T3 p.37].
5. Infosys does not disclose margins externally for AI separately from other work [T1 p.21].
